description: Governed slice backlog for the autonomous production loop. Slices with ownerGated=true are recorded for the owner and are NEVER auto-promoted by the feeder. Promotable slices are offline-doable, fail-closed, deterministic work; live provider, OAuth, publishing, and analytics slices stay owner-gated per AGENTS.md Rules 7, 16, and 17.

slices.title: AI News narration input registry and deterministic subtitle plan stage
slices.brief: Stage 4 of the AI News pipeline (Module 27/21). Add src/aiNews/deterministicSubtitlePlan.js: a narration-input registry that validates owner/agent-supplied timed narration segments (monotonic, non-overlapping, bounded start/end/text, no invented content) and converts an approved editorial plan plus registered segments into a deterministic subtitle plan. Fail closed with stable reason codes; no provider calls; no media generation; publication stays not_requested; Rules 15/17 enforced.
acceptance: Registry validates timed segments: strictly ordered, non-overlapping, bounded durations and text lengths; malformed input throws stable codes
Subtitle plan is deterministic (SHA-256 plan id) and echoes supplied segment text only
Blocked or tampered upstream plans yield truthful blocked results, never drafts
Unit tests cover happy path, determinism, and fail-closed rejections; npm test and npm run verify pass
docs/aiNews/SUBTITLE_PLAN_CONTRACT.md documents the contract; no new dependencies

slices.title: AI News content package orchestrator chaining verified stages
slices.brief: Generalize the proven JARVIS orchestrator pattern (src/jarvis/contentPackageOrchestrator.js) to AI News: src/aiNews/contentPackageOrchestrator.js chains research brief -> editorial plan -> metadata/thumbnail plan -> subtitle plan into one deterministic package with stage-by-stage integrity (recomputed ids), truthful blocked propagation, and zero generation or publication.
acceptance: Chains the four existing AI News stage modules via their public contracts only
Each stage's plan id is recomputed and verified before the next stage runs; tampering fails closed
A blocked upstream stage yields a truthful blocked package with the original reason code
Package provenance reports zero provider calls, zero generated assets, publication not_requested
Unit tests cover determinism, chaining, blocked propagation, and tamper rejection; docs updated

slices.title: Owner API: content package runs and evidence timeline read routes
slices.brief: Module 18 owner-dashboard surface, part 1. Add authenticated, safe-DTO read routes to the owner API (src/api/**) exposing content package runs and the evidence timeline (hash chain positions, artifact hashes, provider attempt metadata) for the requesting owner only. Cross-owner access fails closed; secrets, locators, and internal agent names are never serialized.
acceptance: Routes require a valid authenticated session and scope every query to the session owner
Responses use an explicit safe DTO allowlist; unknown, secret-bearing, and internal-name fields are blocked
Malformed or cross-scope requests yield clean 4xx with allowlisted error codes
Unit tests cover auth, scoping, DTO allowlist, and error shapes; docs updated; no new dependencies

slices.title: Owner API: job control, approval queue, and emergency pause routes
slices.brief: Module 18 owner-dashboard surface, part 2. Add authenticated mutation routes (CSRF-protected) for job retry/cancel within owner scope, listing the pending owner-approval queue, and triggering the existing emergency-pause contract (src/resilience/**). Every mutation writes an audit event. Approvals bind exact artifact hashes; publishing approval remains out of scope for this slice.
acceptance: All mutations require session + CSRF + ownership + audit event (AGENTS.md Rule 6)
Job retry/cancel operates only on jobs owned by the session owner and respects terminal states
Emergency pause reuses the existing resilience contract; status is reflected in read routes
Unit tests cover auth, CSRF, scoping, audit, and fail-closed paths; docs updated

slices.title: Cloud operation health manifest and truthful scheduled self-audit
slices.brief: Module 28 offline portion. Add a health manifest (automation/operations/health-manifest.json) listing the autonomous workflows and their required credentials, plus a scheduled audit step that truthfully reports which workflows are runnable (credential configured or not) and records the report as a workflow-run artifact or issue comment. No fake green: missing credentials are reported as PAUSED, never success.
acceptance: Manifest schema is validated by a pure module with stable error codes
Audit output distinguishes RUNNABLE vs PAUSED (missing credential) per workflow; never fabricates availability
Scheduled workflow runs the audit and surfaces the truthful report
Unit tests cover schema validation and report classification; docs updated

slices.title: Backlog feeder records completion durably in git
slices.brief: Actions-run evidence showed the feeder wrote automation/backlog/lifecycle.json only into the ephemeral workspace: completion credit was lost between runs, so dependency-gated slices (S-M27-01) can never unlock. Make the runner commit and push lifecycle.json to the default branch when a completion is recorded (loud failure on push errors, honest no-op when unchanged), seed the file with the evidenced S-M21-01 completion, and document the durability contract.
acceptance: Runner commits and pushes automation/backlog/lifecycle.json when a completion is recorded; no-op when the file is unchanged
Push failures exit non-zero with a stable log code; success or failure is never fabricated
Seeded lifecycle contains only slice ids backed by a merged PR and a closed-completed issue
npm test and npm run verify pass; docs updated; no new dependencies

slices.title: Offline load and rate-limit resilience suite for quota and recovery contracts
slices.brief: Module 29 offline portion. Add a deterministic, fully offline stress suite exercising QuotaLedger reservation/commit/release under burst-shaped call patterns, RecoveryContractManager circuit transitions under repeated failure injection, and expired-lease reclaim under concurrent claim attempts. Assert bounded memory/time behavior and no quota leakage; no network, no providers.
acceptance: Burst reservation patterns show zero quota leakage (every reserve is committed or released exactly once)
Circuit breaker reaches OPEN and recovers per contract under injected failure sequences
Expired-lease reclaim is safe under simulated concurrent claims (no double-claim in the deterministic model)
Suite runs offline in npm test with bounded duration; docs updated

slices.title: Additive catalog registration for the NEWTON Director Agent (canonical 15-division alignment)
slices.brief: The owner's canonical specification defines 15 divisions including NEWTON (Indian current affairs, government schemes, defence, education and employment opportunities), but the seeded catalog does not include it. Register NEWTON additively wherever the catalog source of truth lives (catalog module plus a new additive seed migration), including the same per-agent connection-slot invariants every other agent has (one email slot, one unconfigured slot per supported platform), while respecting the 50-agent hard cap and all identity/isolation rules. Never edit existing migrations (R1); never alter existing agent rows.
acceptance: New additive migration (next sql/NNN number) seeds the NEWTON agent row and its connection slots idempotently; migrations 001+ are byte-identical
Catalog module registers NEWTON with niche, universe, and charter scaffolding consistent with existing agents; 50-agent hard cap still enforced
NEWTON has exactly the same connection-slot and isolation invariants as existing agents (no cross-agent sharing)
Internal name NEWTON never reaches public-facing serialization (Rule 15); DTO allowlists unchanged
Unit tests cover registration, cap enforcement, slot invariants, and idempotent migration; PostgreSQL integration covers the new migration; docs updated

slices.title: Deterministic per-agent package-profile manifest (canonical 1 long-form + 2 Shorts + 1 promo Reel)
slices.brief: The owner's canonical specification defines the standard production package as exactly 1 long-form episode (YouTube + Bilibili only), 2 independent standalone Shorts, and 1 promotional Reel (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, Snapchat Spotlight). The existing JARVIS planner contract specifies 3 standalone Shorts. Add a deterministic, additive per-agent package-profile layer that expresses the canonical package as the default profile, preserves JARVIS's existing 3-Shorts contract under its own profile until the owner explicitly decides otherwise, and emits a platform-adaptation manifest (pure module) mapping each package output to allowed destinations. No silent rewrite of any existing planner contract (R5); no publishing happens in this slice.
acceptance: Pure deterministic module produces a package-profile manifest with recomputed SHA-256 ids; tampered inputs fail closed with stable codes

Canonical default profile encodes 1 long-form + 2 Shorts + 1 promo Reel with destination allowlists (long-form: YouTube, Bilibili; short-form: YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, Snapchat Spotlight)
JARVIS keeps its existing 3-Shorts contract via its own profile; existing planner tests remain untouched and green
No provider calls, no media generation, publication always not_requested; Rules 15/17 enforced in every serialized field
Unit tests cover determinism, profile resolution, fail-closed rejections, and JARVIS compatibility; docs updated

slices.title: Media artifact descriptor and verification-state contract (offline portion of the media layer)
slices.brief: Phase 2/3 critical path, offline portion. Add a pure media-artifact descriptor contract: immutable artifact identity anchored to the SHA-256 content hash, artifact type, MIME type, optional duration/dimensions, producer metadata (agent, run, stage, provider), and a fail-closed verification-state machine (unverified by default; verified only through a real FFprobe-style inspection result supplied by the caller; never fabricated). A worker success that lacks a passing verification result must be representable as unverified, never valid. No media generation, no provider calls, no bundled binaries in this slice.
acceptance: Descriptor validation fails closed with stable codes on missing/invalid hash, type, MIME, or producer fields; hash is the identity anchor and tampering with any payload field is detectable
Verification-state machine: unverified -> verified only via a supplied inspection result with matching content hash; any mismatch or missing inspection keeps unverified
Serialized output uses a strict field allowlist; no secrets, locators, or internal agent names (Rules 15/17)
Deterministic: identical inputs produce byte-identical descriptors; no clocks in the identity
Unit tests cover determinism, tamper detection, verification transitions, and allowlist serialization; docs updated; no new dependencies

slices.title: OWNER-GATED: real free-provider credential onboarding
slices.brief: Module 20 live portion. Requires the owner to configure the three private provider slots per agent with secret-manager locators and quota metadata. Cannot be automated: per AGENTS.md Rules 4, 5, and 16 the owner must supply credentials through the secret manager. This slice is recorded for tracking only; the feeder must never promote it.
acceptance: Owner supplies secret-manager locators and free-tier quota metadata through the owner-controlled secret manager
Live quota snapshots wired into dispatch admission are verified with real provider evidence before any claim of operation

slices.title: OWNER-GATED: OAuth and social-account connection
slices.brief: Module 19 live portion. Requires the owner to configure each agent's unconfigured email/social connection slots with real OAuth grants (YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat). Per AGENTS.md Rule 16 live OAuth remains pending owner action. Recorded for tracking only; never auto-promoted.
acceptance: Owner performs OAuth connection per agent slot with rotation and revocation verified through official platform flows

slices.title: OWNER-GATED: live publishing enablement
slices.brief: Module 24 live portion. Private-first publishing and reconciliation exist as contracts; enabling live publishing requires explicit, unexpired owner approval bound to exact artifact hash, destination, caption, affiliate links, and disclosure (AGENTS.md Rule 7). Recorded for tracking only; never auto-promoted.
acceptance: Owner approves an exact immutable publishing snapshot through the owner dashboard; receipts come only from real platform responses

slices.title: OWNER-GATED: live analytics ingestion and optimization loop
slices.brief: Module 26 live portion. Analytics ingestion requires live published content and official platform analytics APIs with owner-configured credentials. No locally invented metrics are ever permitted. Recorded for tracking only; never auto-promoted.
acceptance: Official analytics API credentials configured by the owner; ingestion verified against real platform responses
